text:
The Ann–Ben pair occupies consecutive slots, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and with Gus after Ben and at least three slots from Ann. The only block that also leaves Dev before Gus and at least three slots from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7. That places Gus in 9 and Hana in 8.

Slots 1–5 then hold Cara, Dev, Elif, Finn, and Ivo. Distance from Ben leaves only Elif able to take slot 5. Dev must be at least three slots from both Ann and Cara, so Dev is in 1 and Cara in 4. Finn must be at least three slots from Elif, so Finn is in 2 and Ivo is in 3.
